name: Server Meshing Test Rig
description:
The test rig for the Server Meshing add-on: two test maps cut into ten cells (a 3x3 grid plus one cell across a seam), test items, skills, quests, mounts, pets, harvestables and buildings that exercise every path across a cell edge.
Adds an auto client, an editor launcher and play runner, a load generator, and the Python regression and capacity harnesses under TestMap/Tools: 27 scenarios, eleven of the mesh itself, fourteen of dynamic cells (split, merge, crashes, the automatic policy, buildings across a cut, and a central restart with the central run as its own process) and two of on-demand links.
Needs the Server Meshing add-on and the kit's BaseDemo (the test data references its enemy prefab and default weapon).
